terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use explain the conditions for using the Lens Viva app. Please read them carefully.
terms.acceptanceText: By installing or using Lens Viva, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with them, do not use the app.
terms.licenseText: You may use Lens Viva on your own devices for personal, non-commercial purposes. This permission is personal and cannot be transferred.
terms.licenseAsIs: The app is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
terms.howItWorksText: Lens Viva reads camera text and joins lines of the same sentence. A configured online service translates the sentence in context; without a connection, available offline packs are used.
terms.howItWorksImages: Camera images are processed in real time. They are not stored and are not sent to any server.
terms.howItWorksHistory: History is optional and turned off by default. When you turn it on, translated texts are saved only on this device until you delete them.
terms.thirdPartyText: Text recognition and offline translation use Google ML Kit. Online translation uses the configured service, which may forward text to Gemini.
terms.thirdPartyDownloads: Language packs are downloaded from Google servers when you request them. Google's own terms and privacy policy apply to these downloads.
terms.accuracyText: Translations are generated automatically by machine translation and may be incomplete or wrong.
terms.accuracyWarning: Do not rely on them for safety, medical, legal or financial decisions. Always check important information against the original text or with a qualified professional.
terms.privacyText: Settings and optional history stay on the device. Online translation sends text and context to the configured service, subject to the provider’s policy.
terms.privacyDeletion: You can delete them at any time in {{settings}} › {{action}}. Downloaded language packs can be removed in {{languages}}.
terms.changesText: These terms may be updated, for example when new features are added. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. If you keep using the app after a change, you accept the updated terms.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these terms, contact the developer through the app's listing in the store where you downloaded it.
